def _t():
    name = 'Python'
    inner = t'{name}'
    t = t'Language: {inner}'
    t_interp = t.interpolations[0]
    assert t.strings == ('Language: ', ''), ('assertEqual', t.strings, ('Language: ', ''))
    assert t_interp.value.strings == ('', ''), ('assertEqual', t_interp.value.strings, ('', ''))
    assert t_interp.value.interpolations[0].value == name, ('assertEqual', t_interp.value.interpolations[0].value, name)
    assert t_interp.value.interpolations[0].expression == 'name', ('assertEqual', t_interp.value.interpolations[0].expression, 'name')
    assert t_interp.value.interpolations[0].conversion == None, ('assertEqual', t_interp.value.interpolations[0].conversion, None)
    assert t_interp.value.interpolations[0].format_spec == '', ('assertEqual', t_interp.value.interpolations[0].format_spec, '')
    assert t_interp.expression == 'inner', ('assertEqual', t_interp.expression, 'inner')
    assert t_interp.conversion == None, ('assertEqual', t_interp.conversion, None)
    assert t_interp.format_spec == '', ('assertEqual', t_interp.format_spec, '')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
